title: Machine learning selects a 13-gene liver fibrosis signature with GABRE as candidate
summary: From merged GEO datasets and WGCNA, 78 machine learning algorithms narrowed 42 genes to a 13-gene signature including GABRE for liver fibrosis. One dataset was reserved for external validation and qRT-PCR confirmed the expression patterns. The signature correlated with immune cell populations. The work is biomarker discovery and not clinical.
ai_technology: Seventy-eight machine learning algorithm combinations for signature gene selection
organization: Macau University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: External GEO dataset validation and qRT-PCR confirmation of gene expression.
evidence.unknown: Diagnostic accuracy values and clinical benefit are not given in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
